headline: Sensex Plunges 989 Points, Nifty Slips Below 25,650 Dragged by IT Stocks and HDFC Bank

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Bears took control of the stock market as Sensex plunged nearly 989 points.
Nifty 50 fell below the key 25,650 level to trade near 25,600.
Heavyweight IT stocks and HDFC Bank faced selling pressure, dragging the indices down.
Market sentiment turned negative, wiping out gains from the previous two sessions.
whatHappening: Sensex plummeted 989 points while Nifty 50 closed around 25,600 on November 27.
RBI reduced the daily CRR maintenance requirement to 90% starting December 1, unlocking over ₹40,000 crore.
HDFC Bank emerged as a key drag on the benchmark indices during today's market drop.
Tata Sons cautioned that deferring its November 30 meeting would breach the December 10 RBI listing deadline.
summary: Indian equities experienced a severe sell-off on November 27, with the Sensex dropping 989 points and Nifty sliding below 25,650. Heavyweights including HDFC Bank and major IT stocks dragged the market lower. Meanwhile, the RBI announced a reduction in CRR maintenance requirement to 90%, expected to release ₹40,000 crore into the financial system.
